Stage.LogText: {=sp_gt1_s0_log}You left the artisan lifeless in his workshop. With city guards scouring the streets, you must lay low and blend into the shadows. Wait for the heat to die down... (1 Day)

{=sp_gt1_s1_log}As the alert faded, a black-feathered pigeon landed under your cloak. Someone recognized the bone seal you claimed from the artisan's corpse. Travel near {GolgeSiginagi_Link} and speak with the Shadow Courier {GolgeUlagi_Link}.

{=sp_gt1_s2_log}The courier confirmed the artisan was leaking the Pigeon archives to rival kingdoms. Prove your blind loyalty: Ambush and eliminate the 50-man foreign guard detachment {RakipAjanlar_Link} awaiting the ciphers near {GolgeSiginagi_Link}.

{=sp_gt1_s_success_log}You butchered the foreign spies. The Shadow Roost approved your ruthlessness and blind devotion. You are no longer a mere pawn; you are now an executioner of the shadows. You received the 'Shadow Bone Dagger' and 30,000 denars.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_gt1_dlg1}You bear the raven bone seal taken from the slain artisan... The Shadow Roost knows what you did.
{=sp_gt1_dlg1_p}I was told someone here recognizes this raven bone cipher.

{=sp_gt1_dlg2}The artisan was not merely a thorn; he was selling our deepest cipher archives to foreign kingdoms. You ended his breath, yet your blind loyalty must be proven by blood. A detachment of 50 foreign deserters waits near {GolgeSiginagi_Link} to purchase the stolen ciphers. Slay them all. Leave no tongue to tell the tale.
{=sp_gt1_dlg3}Blind loyalty knows no hesitation. Their blood will water the mountain.
